caption: The video captures a hazy, low-contrast scene dominated by a swirling gray-blue mist that fills most of the view. Bare brownish branches hang along the top edge, while dark green leafy tree silhouettes crowd the right side and lower-right corner. A small pale point appears near the center-right and slowly drifts downward through the haze. The mist churns continuously, its darker and lighter patches slowly drifting and deforming across the view. This internal reshaping alters the clouded texture while the surrounding branches and trees remain largely in place. The point's descent is slight but steady, with only a small sideways shift against the moving haze. The overall layout remains broadly steady as the haze continues its quiet turbulence. No obvious expansion occurs; the visible change is confined to the soft reshaping of the smoky region and the slow movement of the pale point.
relations: The gray-blue mist continuously churns, causing darker and lighter patches to slowly drift and deform across the view.
A small pale point near the center-right slowly drifts downward through the haze with a slight sideways shift.
Surrounding bare branches and dark green trees remain largely in place while the mist reshapes around them.
